items.title: Claude apps release notes: 2026-11-24
items.snippet: Monthly recap is out of beta · The monthly recap (Reflect, in Settings) is now out of beta for Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra plans on the web, Claude Desktop, and Claude for iOS and Android. Recaps can now draw on your Claude Code sessions and Claude Cowork tasks in the cloud, and you can delete your stored recaps from the page. For more information, see See your monthly recap . · Install artifacts as apps (beta) · You can now install an artifact that Claude makes for you as an app on your Mac or Windows computer. It gets its own window and icon, opens like any other app, and can even interact with the operating system the way any other app might. This feature is currently in beta. For more information, see Install an app as an artifact . · Send files to connected apps and save files from them (beta) · Claude can now send a file to an app you've connected, or save a file that the app offers. File transfers with connectors are rolling out gradually in beta on Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and on Team and Enterprise plans when an owner turns them on. For more information, see Send files to connected apps and save files from them .

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.332 → 2.1.332
items.snippet:
2.1.332
- Added skills from MCP servers (beta). They show as `server:skill` in the `/` menu; other skills keep their names
- Added a `PreSkillShellCommand` hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads; on 2.1.331 and older, a settings file naming it opens a dialog at start
- Added "Always deliver" to the prompt for held messages from other sessions
- Added a footer line that stays while a flagged message has your session on a different model, until you pick one with `/model`
- Added an OpenTelemetry `assistant_response` event for text Claude sends through SendUserMessage or Cowork's message tool, when response logging is on
- Added a warning in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when part of a session couldn't be saved, saying how to save it with `/compact`
- Added a notice in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when a resumed session's earlier messages weren't loaded, as the terminal already shows
- Added your Cyber Verification Program access tier to the startup header, beside the model name when your tier applies to that model and you're signed in with a claude.ai account
